alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued November 17 at 12:13AM EST until November 19 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Miami FL
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...A portion of southeast Florida, including the following
areas, Coastal Broward County, Coastal Miami Dade County, Far South
Miami-Dade County, Inland Broward County, Inland Miami-Dade County,
Inland Palm Beach County, Metro Broward County and Metropolitan
Miami Dade.

* WHEN...From this afternoon through Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Several rounds of storms may produce rainfall amounts of 2 to 4
inches  through Friday. Higher amounts of 6 to 8 inches with
locally isolated amounts up to 10 inches may be possible. Heavy
rainfall rates of 1 to 2 inches per hour may observed with some
of these storms.
- http:/
